entities.name: Włodzimierz Sieradzki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Włodzimierz Jan Sieradzki was a Polish physician, specializing in forensic medicine. He was a professor at Jan Kazimierz University and served as its rector during the academic year 1924–1925.
